ethics.fact: On November 11, 2026, the House Committee on Ethics site search for the surname "LaHood" returned a page stating that nothing matched the search terms. The Office of Congressional Conduct investigations index, pages 0 through 12, did not list Darin LaHood. The published rule adds ethics points only when a public finding or sanction on these sources names the member, so this component is 0. It is not a statement that a private inquiry does not exist.
